She looks at the snow scene outside the window, then turns back to look at the notes and books piled up on the desk. Her cat jumps on the table and looks at her curiously.

[Question]
What does Xiao Li do after receiving Xiao Wang's call?

[Candidate Answers]
A. She reviews the questions she gets wrong before.
B. She plays with her cat to relieve the pressure of studying.
C. She goes out to the cafe to meet the botanist.
